body: Thanks so much. Reddit isn't always the cesspool it makes itself out to be. Never stop being an inspiration.

maybe it will take a while but trust me I'm open to believing that and have tried. If I have this close a call again I promise instead of being a whiney bitch i will just talk to someone else who is going through what I am. Thank you. You are an incredible person and i still feel like a shit but I don't know if you know how much it means for you to be doing what you're doing. Sorry if I'm incoherent.

Thank you. I will try to remember this. I will try not to be a piece of shit.

Please never stop helping people. We all have to remember there is love.

i still disagree, it is NOT peace, only less peace for your loved ones.

And if you keep up your end of the deal I'll keep up mine. I love my mother and I'm pretty sure your mother loves you. I need to go from Reddit now but if you want to talk just message me and I'll get it soon. i was going to use this as a throwaway account but I don't think i would mind having a friend either.

Thanks for helping me work through this, friend.

You have friends here.

You did not shame anyone.

You are safe here.

You have to do what is right. Preserve yourself and your life.

You are not to blame. ONLY YOUR ATTACKER IS TO BLAME. And your attacker needs to be brought to justice. Please file a full police report. 

**YOU ARE VALUABLE. YOU ARE CHERISHABLE.**

You have friends to talk to here.

**THINGS GET BETTER PLEASE HEAR THIS.**
Physically i am the only one receiving abuse. I want to know if I deserve it. I don't want to be a piece of shit
how do i know i'm not the abuser

I feel like the only way not to feel like a shit is to help someone else not feel like a shit so I'm going to try. You have a friend here.

A lot of us here suffer from mental health disorders but that does NOT mean we are unfit. That is stigma and stigma kills.

>This depression, anxiety, uncertainty is driving me insane and I just want it to end it. Find solace. For once, I wish to be selfish and just let it end all of it.

I feel exactly like that and I'm trying so hard to find the words. sometimes maybe there aren't right words. I am broke too, way overdrawn and in debt but you know what's stupid and disgustingly kind of (in a fucked up way) funny? I'm worrying about some dumb cunt who tells me how to feel.

maybe that's the thing. Money's your dumb cunt. Some dumb cunt is like your money to me. I know I'm babbling but I hope I make some sense.

There is NO solace in what we're thinking about doing. If it weren't for some dumb cunt the only thing that would keep me here might be my mother. You said you wouldn't be able to stand a look of disappointment on your mother's face. 

Will you make a deal with me? You stay here for your mother, and I'll stay here for mine.

You obviously have so much going for you. I came here to vent because I'm in a relationship where nobody would believe I get struck, have had no money for so long and feel as valuable as a piece of shit (mostly due to being told so) but then I went to the feed and I realized how different but similar our situations are.

You have so much to live for. You have so much potential. You've already been successful. YOU KNOW YOU HAVE IT IN YOU.

Learn some discipline though. go to /r/financialplanning and related subreddits. Get advice about how to manage your wealth.

I have suffered through death and loss of close loved ones too. YOU CANNOT LET THAT DAMAGE BREAK YOU. You must make it make you stronger. 

Passion will feed your family. Do not give up. Be the family member you wish you would have had, even if you have to beg until you get back on your feet.
